aspects.says: An instant saved for a future appointment shows the wrong wall-clock time once the zone's rules change; a local date-time plus a region id resolves under the rules in force.
basis: section:Store a Future Appointment as Local Time and Zone, and Work Out the Instant Late

aspects.says: ZonedDateTime.of moves a local time in a gap later by the gap's length and takes the earlier offset in an overlap, without an exception; getValidOffsets tells the cases apart so the code can decide.
basis: section:Near a Clock Change a Local Time Can Be Missing or Doubled, and ZonedDateTime Picks One Without Telling You

aspects.says: An OffsetDateTime keeps the offset it was created with, so calendar arithmetic across a clock change gives the wrong wall-clock time; a ZonedDateTime asks its zone's rules for the new offset.
basis: section:An OffsetDateTime Keeps One Offset; Only a ZonedDateTime Follows the Zone's Rules

aspects.says: A ZonedDateTime whose zone is an offset, as ZonedDateTime.parse gives for text without a region id, never changes offset; only a region id carries the rules.
basis: section:A Zone Written as an Offset Has No Rules

aspects.says: In an overlap, ZonedDateTime.of gives the first occurrence unless withLaterOffsetAtOverlap picks the second.
basis: section:Near a Clock Change a Local Time Can Be Missing or Doubled, and ZonedDateTime Picks One Without Telling You

aspects.says: withZoneSameInstant keeps the moment and recomputes the wall clock; withZoneSameLocal keeps the wall clock and so changes the moment.
basis: section:withZoneSameInstant Converts a Moment; withZoneSameLocal Moves It

aspects.says: Stepping each occurrence from the previous one carries a gap's shift into every later week; computing occurrence k from the first confines it to the week of the gap.
basis: section:Spot the Problem: The Weekly Maintenance Window

aspects.says: The difference between two zones depends on the date, because they change their clocks on different days, so it can't be a constant.
basis: section:withZoneSameInstant Converts a Moment; withZoneSameLocal Moves It
